name: Screen/Server Detail — Modpacks — Confirm install (version change)

children.name: subheading
children.text: Pick a pack and a version. The server pins that version and restarts to install it; a restart never upgrades it.

children.name: mDesc
children.text: test-server-02 restarts to install the pack. It stays on this version until you change it.

children.name: Backup First
texts: Takes a backup to the cluster’s backup destination (s3-backups). The server version changes right away; the pack is installed only after the backup succeeds.

children.name: Version Change Warning
texts: The server version changes from Latest · Fabric to 26.1.2 · NeoForge. The server restarts on the new version right away, before any backup finishes.
